facts.text: An excavator is a digging machine with a long jointed arm and a bucket, mounted on a body that can rotate a full circle on top of its tracks or wheels.
facts.quote: An excavator is a digging machine with a long jointed arm and a bucket, mounted on a body that can rotate a full circle on top of its tracks or wheels.

facts.text: An excavator's counterweight and arm sweep a wide circle during swing and can strike a person or truck without the machine moving forward or backward.
facts.quote: the counterweight at the back and the arm at the front sweep a wide circle, and a person or truck inside it can be struck without the machine moving forward or backward at all.

facts.text: ISO 21815-4 was under publication in October 2026.
ISO 21815-4 covers swing and rotation and relies mainly on preventing rotation from starting when something is in the way, rather than braking during the swing.
facts.quote: covers swing and rotation and relies mainly on preventing the rotation from starting when something is in the way, rather than braking during the swing [Chapter 4]

facts.text: No agency statistics were found that separately quantify how often excavator swing strikes cause serious collisions.
facts.quote: No agency statistics were found that separate out how often swing strikes cause serious collisions [Chapter 4].

facts.text: Komatsu's KomVision on hydraulic excavators detects people with cameras.
facts.quote: Komatsu's KomVision on hydraulic excavators detects people with cameras

facts.text: Komatsu's KomVision on hydraulic excavators stops the machine when travel or swing starts, but not during an ongoing swing.
facts.quote: stops the machine when travel or swing starts, but not during an ongoing swing

facts.text: Komatsu's KomVision on hydraulic excavators must be switched off during trailer loading because a rapid stop can make the machine unstable.
facts.quote: it must be switched off during trailer loading because a rapid stop "can make the machine unstable" [Chapter 2].

facts.text: Rotating motions in job-site collision mitigation need their own detection zones and their own kind of intervention, rather than being treated only as driving collisions.
facts.quote: a job-site collision is not only driving into something; rotating motions need their own detection zones and their own kind of intervention

facts.text: An automatic stop on an excavator can itself create a stability hazard.
facts.quote: an automatic stop can itself create a stability hazard.
